She is an active Employee, a Sales Rep in Austin, TX, in cost center CC-3000 Sales, and her manager is Owen Iyer (E1009). The two records have different tokenised government IDs, so they are different people. The new hire gets a new account. The Workday steps wait until the account exists. The "Create accounts and email" task is only marked complete after the email write-back finishes successfully.
